title: Sinigang
description: A heartwarming Soup that is usually mixed with Tamarind to reach that iconic sour flavor. Could be used for Pork, Fish and Shrimps.

title: Adobo
description: A rich, flavorful meal where either chicken or pork is bathed in a soy-based sauce.

title: Lechon
description: The National Dish of the country. A whole pig is roasted slowly with spices inside until it reaches that crispy skin texture outside.

title: Papaitan
description: From the word 'Pait', it means bitter. It uses the goat's bile to make the soup slightly bitter. Its a popular dish in the Northern Philippines.

title: Inasal
description: Grilled Marinated Chicken Thigh or Wing, paired with soy sauce and calamansi (Philippine Lime).

title: Guso
description: Seaweed mixed with vinegar and spices. It helps you taste the ocean, clease your palate, and feel that gelatin-like texture.

title: Kare-kare
description: Beef Stew mixed with peanut butter and paired with blanched vegatables.

title: Beef Tapa
description: Thinly sliced beef, marinated with flavorful sauce overnight and then stir-fried to perfection. Best paired with eggs and garlic rice.

title: Pinakbet
description: The famous Vegetable Stew of the Philippines. Vegetables like Squash, Eggplant, Okra, and String beans are mixed with shrimp paste and soy-based sauce.

title: Dinuguan
description: The Blood stew. Pig innards is mixed with blood flavored and cooked until it reaches that creamy texture and brown to black color

title: Bulad
description: Salted and Dried Fish. It was one of the oldest way to preserve food in the country. Best paired with Vinegar to balance the saltiness of the fish.

title: Lumpia
description: Connected with its Chinese roots, this dish is veggies or meat stuffed inside a wrapper and fried till golden brown. Bast paired with ketchup or sweet & sour sauce.

title: Pancit Bilao
description: Still from Chinese roots, this filipino dish highlights noodles mixed with a soy-based sauce and mixed with sliced veggies, shrimp, and meat.

title: Halo-halo
description: A cool Dessert where crushed ice is topped with Ice Cream, jackfruit, sweet beans, gelatin, bananas, and more. Then sweeted with Condensed and Evaporated milk. Perfect for the dry season.

title: Kinilaw
description: The Philippine Sushi. Raw fish, mostly tuna, is mixed with vinegar and spices, giving you that refreshing and melt in your mouth texture.
